items.title: Relation between Angular and Linear Velocities (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Relation between Angular and Linear Velocities: a main subheading of 3.1 Angular measurements, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 54-54.

blocks.text: Ek rigid body lein jo z-axis ke gird angular velocity ω se ghoom rahi hai (Fig. 3.5a).

blocks.alt: Vertical z-axis, oopar ke qareeb mura teer jis par ω likha hai. Gulabi rigid body axis par O se nikla hai, us ke andar dashed line r, O se point P tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5(a): z-axis ke gird angular velocity ω se ghoomta rigid body (kitab ki Figure 3.5(a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Object mein axis se perpendicular faasle r par ek point P sochein; OP reference line hai. Object ghoomta hai to P radius r ke daire par linear velocity v se chalta hai aur OP angular velocity ω se ghoomti hai (Fig. 3.5b). Hum ω aur v ka relation nikalna chahte hain. Axis fixed hai, is liye ω ki direction hamesha ek hi rehti hai aur ω ko scalar ki tarah le sakte hain. P ki linear velocity ki bhi sirf magnitude lenge, jo scalar hai.

blocks.alt: Horizontal daira elliptical shakal mein, centre O; y-axis daen, x-axis dekhne wale ki taraf aur z-axis oopar, jis par mota neela teer ω hai. O se radius daire ke agle hisse par P₁ aur P₂ tak jate hain; OP₁ x-axis se angle θ banata hai, OP₁ aur OP₂ ke beech chhota angle Δθ hai, aur arc par P₁ se P₂ tak teer par ΔS likha hai. OP₁ par r likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5(b): Jab OP Δθ ghoomta hai to point P arc P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai (kitab ki Figure 3.5(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: ω ka teer z-axis par upar hai kyunke upar se dekhne par object anticlockwise ghoom raha hai (right hand rule). Chhote waqt Δt mein OP angle Δθ ghoomti hai aur P arc ΔS chalta hai: ΔS = rΔθ. Axis se jitna door point, utni zyada us ki linear speed.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Farz karein waqt Δt mein P faasla P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai aur isi dauran OP angular displacement Δθ radian tay karti hai. Eq. 3.1 se:

blocks.alt: Zameen par radius r ke pahiye ki do haalatein. Pehli mein point A zameen ko chhoo raha hai aur B kinare par oopar ki taraf hai; mura teer dikhata hai ke pahiya daen ludhakte hue clockwise ghoomta hai. Doosri mein pahiya angle θ ghoom chuka hai: ab B zameen ko chhoota hai aur A oopar kinare par hai. Kinare ki arc AB aur zameen ka utna hissa marked hain, aur do chhoone ke points ka faasla S = r θ hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 57): jab pahiya angle θ ghoomta hai to zameen par tangential faasla S = r θ tay karta hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Pahiya phisle baghair ludhakta hai, is liye kinare ka jitna arc AB zameen ko chhoota hai, pahiya utna hi aage barhta hai. Arc ki lambai rθ hai (θ radian mein), is liye pahiya S = rθ aage jata hai. Yahi Eq. 3.1 hai.

blocks.title: Point to Ponder (Sochiye)

blocks.text: Jab Δt → 0 ho to ΔS/Δt point P ki speed v hai jis se woh daire par chal raha hai, aur Δθ/Δt reference line OP ki angular velocity ω hai. Is liye Eq. 3.6 yeh ban jati hai:

Fig. 3.5(b) mein P arc P₁P₂ par chal raha hai. Jab Δt → 0 ho to arc P₁P₂ bohat chhota ho jata hai aur us ki direction point P₁ par daire ki tangent ki direction hoti hai. Yani P ki velocity ki magnitude v hai aur direction hamesha us point par tangent ke saath hai. Isi liye P ki linear velocity ko tangential velocity bhi kehte hain.
Isi tarah agar OP angular acceleration α se ghoome to P ka linear (tangential) acceleration aₜ hota hai. Eq. 3.7 se yeh relation nikalta hai:

Eq. 3.7 aur 3.8 batati hain ke ghoomte object par axis se different (alag alag) faaslon wale points ki speed aur acceleration alag alag hoti hai, magar fixed axis par ghoomti rigid body ke sab points ki angular displacement, angular speed aur angular acceleration har waqt ek jaisi hoti hai. Is liye angular quantities se poore object ki motion aasani se bayan ho jati hai.

Top par aap ka wazan (aur seat ka zor) centripetal force ka kaam karta hai jo aap ko daire mein rakhta hai. Agar speed itni ho ke v²/r ≥ g, to zaroori centripetal force wazan se zyada ya barabar hai, aur aap seat se nahi hat-te; is liye neeche nahi girte.
